# Shramko SOG LOD Converter

> Free browser tool (https://sog.flyreelstudio.eu) by Andrii Shramko that converts huge 3D Gaussian Splatting PLY files (hundreds of millions of splats, 10+ GB) into a SuperSplat-ready Streamed SOG .zip with real levels of detail (LOD) and SOG compression. Runs on the user's own GPU (WebGPU) and CPU; the file is never uploaded. Open source, MIT: https://github.com/AndriiShramko/shramko-sog-lod-converter

## Key facts
- Output: Streamed SOG archive — lod-meta.json at the zip root + SOG units (meta.json + WebP textures) in sub-folders; ZIP64 for archives over 4 GB; accepted by superspl.at's upload (limit 10 GB per upload).
- LOD policy (same as SuperSplat's server side): each level keeps half of the previous until a level holds ≤ 1,000,000 splats → 1 + ceil(log2(N / 1M)) levels (259M splats → 10 levels).
- Large scenes are processed in spatial tiles sized to the RAM the user allows (browser tabs are capped near 16 GB; single buffers near 2 GB).
- Engine: PlayCanvas splat-transform 3.8.0 (MIT) for decimation and SOG/LOD writing, WebGPU via the PlayCanvas engine.
- The finished archive is read back from disk and verified (levels, chunk files, counts, accepted file names).
- A Streamed SOG built from a single PLY without decimated levels has only one level (no LOD) — a common mistake this tool avoids and its verifier detects.
